title: 3-2-1 Ribs
steps: Rinse the ribs under cold water to remove bone dust, then dry with a paper towel.
Separate and save any non-rib meat, then remove any silverskin from the backside of the rib. The non-rib meat can be smoked like a skirt steak for 60-90 minutes using all the same seasonings.
Slather all the ribs in a generous coating of yellow mustard. This will help the rub stick in the next step.
Coat all the sides of the ribs very generously with the spice rub -- sometimes it’s good to use a light second coating.
Smoke for 3 hours. The ribs pickup all the smoke flavor in this step.
Wrap in foil and smoke for another 2 hours. This is when the ribs become nice and moist.

Unwrap and smoke for 1 more hour, slathering in BBQ sauce every 15-30 minutes. This firms up the exterior a little bit so the ribs don’t fall apart. The BBQ glaze will also caramelize into a nice crust, giving the ribs an extra depth of flavor.
